 For the Opposite Party/s : Mr. Sanjay Kumar, APP  ======================================================
 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE HARISH KUMAR  ORAL ORDER 2 13-06-2023 Heard Mr. Anil Prasad Singh, learned counsel for the petitioner and Mr. Sanjay Kumar, learned APP for the State.

The petitioner apprehends his arrest in connection with Sikty P.S. Case No. 276 of 2022 registered for the offences punishable under Sections 143, 341, 323, 315, 498A, 354, 504 and 506 of the Indian Penal Code and Section 3/4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act.
The petitioner happens to be the husband of the informant (O.P. No.2) whose marriage was solemnized in the year 2020.
However, just after the marriage the informant was subjected to physical and mental torture resulting into lodging of the FIR.
Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.19424 of 2023(2) dt.13-06-2023

Submission has been made on behalf of the petitioner that the informant (O.P. No.2) voluntarily deserted her matrimonial home though the petitioner still wants to keep her with full honour and dignity.

Considering the submissions made on behalf of the petitioner, let notice be issued to the O.P. No. 2,
under both processes i.e. ordinary process as well as registered cover with A/D, for which requisites Md Nasim @ Nasim vs The State Of Bihar on 13 June, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/40536102/
1 etc. must be filed within two weeks.
List the case after receipt of the service of notice or on 25.07.2023, whichever is earlier.
